title: First-turn band blanks when an earlier turn left a turn id behind
context: Measured in runtime/claude-plugin/mod/register.test.ts through the real live.ts state. A prompt.submit, then the hook snapshot, then turn.start, with turnId still set from an earlier turn that had no turn.complete: turnStarted replaces the stamp with its own now, the snapshot is older than the stamp, routeFromEarlierTurn returns true, and the Desktop band is empty (received an empty string, expected Paqad Getting Ready) until the next CLI refresh. The other three cases draw the band: fresh session in both orders, and leftover turn id with turn.start before the snapshot. The spec promises no empty band in the first turn (AC-7, FR-2) and also makes changing the event order or the workflow band guard a non-goal, and AC-33 says an empty band is raised here rather than changed silently. Not measured on a real Desktop session; how often a turn ends with no turn.complete is unknown.
